description: This is a Java integration test class for the ThingPersistenceOperationsActor in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests persistence operations of 'things' against a local MongoDB, including methods for creating and retrieving 'thing' entities, and starting actor instances for testing purposes.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceOperationsActorIT
classes.description: An integration test class for the ThingPersistenceOperationsActor, verifying its persistence functionalities against MongoDB.

methods.name: purgeNamespace
methods.description: A test method that initiates namespace purge to verify cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type for the 'thing' entity.

methods.name: toEntityId
methods.description: Converts a general EntityId to a specific ThingId.

methods.name: getCreateEntityCommand
methods.description: Constructs a CreateThing command with a given ThingId.

methods.name: getCreateEntityResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the create entity response.

methods.name: getRetrieveEntityCommand
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveThing command for a given ThingId.

methods.name: getRetrieveEntityResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the retrieve entity response.

methods.name: getEntityNotAccessibleClass
methods.description: Returns the exception class indicating an entity is not accessible.

methods.name: startActorUnderTest
methods.description: Initializes the actor under test with provided ActorSystem, mediator, and config.

methods.name: startEntityActor
methods.description: Starts a supervisor actor for a specific ThingId entity.
